name: Electrical Systems for Construction Industries
description: Elements of electrical distribution system: distribution transformer, circuit breakers, cables, fuses and protection schemes, introduction to electrical circuits, magnetic circuits, concept of active, reactive power and complex power, power factor, single and three-phase AC supply systems, star and delta connections, power measurement using two-watt meter method, power factor correction, introduction to transformers, principle of operation, EMF equation, equivalent circuit, OC and SC test, regulation. D. C. Motors, 3-phase induction motors and FKW motors starting, speed control and braking. Battery chargers. Introduction to power converters. Fuses and protection schemes. Principles of illumination engineering. Back-up power through UPS and DG sets. Application of electrical systems in air-conditioners, lift, cranes, elevators, pumps etc.
